question: Did any CNC program fail the simulator checks, which check, and on which part?
answer:
Yes. Seven simulator check failures turned up, on two parts:

| Part | Source | Strategy | Failed checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| NIST FTC-10 | real_run | baseline-manual | leftover, rapid_into_stock, flat_plunge |
| SM-105 | variant_part | manual-baseline | gouge, rapid_into_stock |
| SM-105 | variant_part | adaptive-so45-ap2D | gouge, rapid_into_stock |

Each part comes from a single job, and each check failed once. Rapid_into_stock was the only check that failed on both parts. On FTC-10 only the conservative manual-style program failed. On SM-105, which is a demo part derived from SM-101, the adaptive candidate failed the same two checks as the manual-style one, gouge and rapid_into_stock.

keewano_calls.why: Which simulator checks failed, on which part/strategy
keewano_calls.query: SELECT "Part" AS part, "DataSource" AS src, "Strategy" AS strategy, "VerifyCheckFailed" AS chk, count("VerifyCheckFailed") AS fails, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS jobs FROM events WHERE "VerifyCheckFailed" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY part, src, strategy, chk HAVING count("VerifyCheckFailed") > 0 ORDER BY fails DESC
